honest_C3: Greedy collapse [3,3,3,3,3] on the mock is a known artifact of weight-tied embeddings + untrained linear head; it is NOT evidence of bugs in the AR loop. On the real CLM v4 530M ckpt, greedy will produce different (but still likely incoherent) tokens.

Vanilla quality on real ckpt was NOT measured (ckpt on ubu1; agent is local Mac; 60min wall cap). Expected to be LOW per #115 C3 — model was trained for phi_star measurement, not instruction following.

The AR loop uses head_a only. CLM v4's dual-head design (head_a next-byte + head_g prev-byte) means information from head_g is discarded in vanilla generation. This is consistent with standard AR but loses any potential bidirectional benefit.
